en.title: Reviewing and Approving Manual Payment Slips
en.excerpt: Organizer guide to verifying uploaded bank transfer receipts, approving valid payments, and rejecting invalid submission proofs.
en.content:
Manual Payment Approval Queue

When participants choose the manual bank transfer method, their registration status enters Pending Approval after they upload proof of transfer. Organizers monitor these submissions from Event Dashboard > Payments.

Verifying Transfer Slips

Click on any pending payment to open the verification drawer:

  1. Inspect the uploaded receipt image (check transfer date, destination bank, and exact amount paid).
  2. Cross-reference the transaction reference with your organization's bank mobile app or mutasi rekening.

Approve vs Reject Actions

  • Approve: Instantly updates the participant status to Paid, issues their digital ticket, and assigns their category slot.
  • Reject: Prompts the organizer to provide a reason (e.g., Amount does not match invoice or Blurry receipt). The archer receives an instant notification to re-upload proof.
